description: SPEC Appendix A as data, read by scripts/check-forbidden.mjs, which scans tracked code (not *.md prose, docs/archive/**, docs/v2/** or this file) line by line and fails on an error-level hit. literal = case-sensitive substring; regex = ECMAScript RegExp source compiled with flags. level warn marks an identifier that legacy code still uses until the stream that owns that code removes it; flip it to error in the same PR. Appendix A items that plain text matching cannot catch reliably are listed in contracts/README.md.
